description: Quest KACE is a software designed to automate and streamline endpoint management tasks across multiple devices within an organization. The software provides features such as asset inventory, software distribution, patch management, and configuration management. Itenables IT teams to monitor, update, and secure windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints, as well as manage software licenses and compliance requirements. The software aims to address business challenges related to managing and securing endpoints, reducing manual workload, and supporting regulatory compliance by centralizing device control and process automation. Quest KACE also offers tools for service desk integration, remote administration, and vulnerability assessment to assist organizations in maintaining systems and improving overall IT efficiency.
